preconditions.description: The number of digits n must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of operations k must be between 0 and 1,000,000,000.

preconditions.expression: len(d) == n and all(c in '47' for c in d)
preconditions.description: The input array d must have exactly n digits and consist only of the digits 4 and 7.

postconditions.description: The output must be the modified array of digits after k operations.
